description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils providing utility functions for string manipulation, specifically join and split, using external utility classes JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string utility functions for joining linked list elements into a string and splitting a string into a linked list.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
